title: Coverings under the field G-set equivalence
statement: Under the equivalence between etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism] and discrete continuous G=Gal(K^sep/K)-sets, a family of etale maps is a covering of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] exactly when the associated family of equivariant maps is jointly surjective. Consequently, for a discrete G-module M, the assignment S \mapsto Hom_G(S,M) satisfies the sheaf equalizer condition on finite etale objects.

source.place: Tag 03QS, Remark remark-covering-surjective immediately after Lemma lemma-sheaves-point (Tag 03QR); the Hom_G gluing is the abelian-group enrichment used in Tag 04JQ
